name: fleet-deck
description: Compact status entry, Firstmate fleet band and pane, toasts and an optional chime for Claude Code

status.title: Status entry
status.description: Show the compact model, context and account quota entry under the prompt

sound.title: Chime
sound.description: Play a short chime with a fleet toast (worker finished, PR ready, merge landed, failure)

toasts.title: Fleet toasts
toasts.description: Show a toast when a Firstmate worker finishes, a PR is ready, a merge lands or a worker fails
